reviews.author: owen

reviews.title: United Airlines is a great airline for everybody!👍🏻👍🏻👍
reviews.text: On my return flight home from Fort Myers on 12/4/23(this past Monday, two days ago), there were seat back entertainment screens (TVS) and I was entertained the whole flight along with wi-fi. The only thing that happened as we were deplaning in Cleveland was my mom left her wallet on the plane (we were on N16234) in between seats 27A and B. But other then that, United is always and will always be my favorite airline! Keep up the great work, United!👍
reviews.author: Sage Kopp

reviews.title: Mixed bag
reviews.text: UA fails in service. The seat is very comfortable tho no help from setting up for sleep by the flight attendants. Was dressed for a business meeting the next day only to learn pyjamas are no longer on flights less than 14 hrs ( so a 12 hr overnight flight doesnt count?) so had to sleep in my business attire . Service from flight attendants was poor. Meal came on one plate ( so by the time you ate your starters, main course was cold) and all over in 1 hr after takeoff. Despite the attendants offering ice cream for desert it was a pannecotte and not ice cream. When i questioned this, was told thats NZ catering- ok but why call it ice cream. I woke up 1 hr before landing. Had my do not disturb sign on so expected to miss breakfast but no one came around to say good morning or would you like a cup of coffee when i woke 1 hr before landing. Whilst a big improvement on their old business class, theres a long way to go in on board service to justify the cost. Only competition is Air NZ but their business seats are a joke.
reviews.author: pegasusSydney

reviews.title: Ceo
reviews.text: Business class fare RT for this route was about $8000. For this huge premium over coach you get: Use of quite crowded pre flight lounges with pedestrian food and drink, a lie flat cubicle that is so tight as to be dangerous IMO, no pre- boarding, no free wifi, very ordinary food and service not much different than coach, a decent wine selection. For me, never again. I’ll take Jet Blue Mint class which is much less expensive, offers boarding preference, free wifi, larger cubicles, friendly crew!
reviews.author: Visgilio

reviews.title: Not worth the money
reviews.text: The only great product that United provides is the amazing Polaris airport lounge and fine dining. Sadly this high quality product does not extend to the on board flight experience!!! Very narrow seat, tight footwell with little room to move, economy style food and sub standard in flight service for a ticket costing over $14000!! Much needs to be improved they get my money again. One cabin steward kept calling me “Buddy” and no spoon or saucer for a cup of tea.
reviews.author: Frank T

reviews.title: Business Class flight made our vacation end memorable
reviews.text: We got business class flights from Toronto to POS through Houston that was cheaper than economy tickets for the same route on other airlines. This allowed us 2 checked in bags at 70lbs each and hassle free check in at the counter in Toronto Pearson. I think there was a strike action as the normal check in line was very long so this was already welcome. The flight was on time and in flight experience was very professional. Our lounge experience at Houston was good fun. The Houston to POS leg of the flight was exciting and it was my son and wife's first experience in business class. The best? The good in flight service, the wine was shared without hesitation and the quality of the food was excellent.
reviews.author: ErnieRamdeo

reviews.title: United is the champion airline in canceling the flights
reviews.text: Our flight was delayed from Boston by more than an hour. Our second flight from DC to CDG was first delayed then cancelled 5 hours later. We did use their Polaris lounge to book our next flight and get the hotel voucher. We were able to leave DC 24 hours later. The hotel United gave us should really be inspected by the board of health, it was disgusting. Our return flight was also delayed by 4 hours. We decided we had enough and will stop transferring our Chase miles to United. Customer service is rude!

reviews.title: Love United Polaris

reviews.title: Customer Disservice
reviews.text: Our first flight was delayed two hours (for a myriad of reasons, all different from the last) and we were not notified by the United employee when we checked in at the Asheville regional airport. This two hour delay would have resulted in missing our connection and the international flight from LAX to MEL, but we found a flight out of CLT to LAX with absolutely no help from the AVL United employee (he gave us a phone number to call and sent us on our way, saying there was nothing he could do for us, even though he had just finished helping the couple in front of us with the same itinerary delays). Made it to LAX in time to catch the initial flight to MEL after booking the flight ourselves. Made it to our seats only to wind up sitting on the tarmac for two hours due to a flat tire caused by “running over a washer” (read: negligence) on the runway. By the time the tire was fixed, the crew was over their authorized hours, and the flight was canceled. We were told that we would be rebooked to our initial destination (Melbourne), but we were rebooked to Sydney, which is about 539 miles off our initial destination. In order to solve this, we were directed to another United customer service desk where we stood in line for an hour with 50+ United customers dealing with similar “rebooking” issues. It was 2:00 am by the time we were able to talk to a United customer service employee, and good god I wish we hadn’t. For two hours we stood at that counter and did not get a straight answer
reviews.author: Jess R

reviews.title: Absolutely DO NOT RECOMMEND to anyone seeing their military partner.
reviews.text: I can understand TSA having rules and that military do not get a free pass through everything, but the snarkiness, rudeness and lack of regard for mine or my boyfriend's expierence was appalling. Not only did they mock him for asking if he could come with me to the gate, they rolled their eyes and scoffed while we hugged and I cried. They continued to treat my belongings awful and be extremely cold and unwelcoming. It was so noticeable several people came to me to see if I was okay who were also upset by the situation. Lovely to see this is how United treats its military and their loved ones. I understand having rules, but I will never forget this awful expierence and will never fly United again.
reviews.author: Ren C

reviews.title: United Airlines is a Joke
reviews.text: Introduction: In an era where travelers seek seamless journeys and reliable airlines, United Airlines falls short of expectations with its dismal performance at Cancun Airport. As a passenger on flight UA 1049, I experienced an arduous ordeal that lasted over 24 hours, marred by lack of staff and poor communication. The airline's failure to provide timely service and assistance left me frustrated and compelled to seek alternative arrangements using personal funds. This review sheds light on the grievances faced and emphasizes the need for a refund along with additional compensation for the inconveniences endured. Delayed Departure and Lack of Staff: One of the fundamental responsibilities of an airline is to ensure timely departures and arrivals. Unfortunately, United Airlines failed to meet this basic requirement during my experience. Flight UA 1049 was delayed for an extended period, leaving passengers stranded in the Cancun airport for over 24 hours. This delay was attributed to a purported shortage of staff, which is an unacceptable excuse considering the significance of Cancun as a popular tourist destination. Passengers were left in a state of confusion and frustration as the airline struggled to address the situation promptly. Financial Burden and Inadequate Assistance: United Airlines' inability to manage the situation adequately placed an undue financial burden on its passengers. Due to the excessive delay, I had to arrange housing and taxi services at my own expense
reviews.author: Jake M

reviews.title: Breaks their promises and makes customers pay for employee mistakes
reviews.text: Our flight was bumped and United offered us the option of leaving in the morning. I spoke to a supervisor to ask about a hotel. I was told that we could go to the airport to pick up a hotel voucher OR, since that was inconvenient since we were not at the airport yet, we could pay for any hotel out of pocket and as long as we mailed in the receipt, I would be reimbursed for the full amount of the hotel stay (cash or flight credit, my choice). I asked all of the right questions: Any restrictions? Nope. Any specific hotel we had to use? Nope. Dollar amount limit? Nope. Was this already approved? Yes. We stayed at a Marriott (close by and convenient). I promptly submitted the required documentation to United. After several attempts to obtain a status, I was informed by United that while the person that I spoke to was a supervisor and they confirmed what I was told, that United would NOT be reimbursing me any money because THEIR EMPLOYEE gave out inaccurate information. What happened to companies honoring representations made by their employees? I relied on the representation made by a United Airlines supervisor and did everything that I was told to get my hotel stay reimbursed. (A hotel stay that would have not been necessary if they could get their flights to leave on time). If they cannot train their employees on their own policies, that should be on them when a customer makes plans and spends money in reliance on what they were told. Instead, they make their customers pay for

reviews.title: Never again
reviews.text: What kind of an airline cancels an entire OVERSEAS flight and just leaves you hanging with "sorry, weather conditions"? Where? It's June 25th. Is it snowing in Newark? Is it raining hail storms on June 25th so hard that the flights are just running into each other in midair? Or is United just the most incompetent airline? I have no idea. But to leave your customers hanging with no alternative flights or assistance from ANY human overseas with a flight of 20+ hours is honestly the worst thing you can do. We all understand delays, we all understand what could happen, but explain it to us like we're not idiots, and give us another flight.
